basic_details.job_title: NLUO Deputy Warden Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Posts
basic_details.short_information: National Law University Odisha (NLUO) has notified 2 vacancies for the Deputy Warden post on a contract basis under advertisement number NLUO/NTR-04/13.10.2026. Applicants must possess a Bachelor's degree with adequate computer knowledge. The notified consolidated pay is Rs. 50000/- per month. Eligible candidates can apply online using the available details on the Career section of the University website, with the latest date for submission being 10-11-2026 by 5.00 P. M. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NLUO Deputy Warden
content_sections.text: Access the Career section of the University website at official website to find the available application details. Fill out the Google Form. Send a copy of the duly filled-in Google Form, along with all supporting documents and proof of qualifications and experience, to the Registrar, National Law University Odisha, Naraj Road, Sector-13, CDA, Cuttack-753015, Odisha, on or before 10-11-2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only short-listed candidates will be called for Interview. No TA/DA will be given for attending the Interview.

faq.question: Q1. Is the NLUO Deputy Warden post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The post is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible to apply for the Deputy Warden position?
faq.answer: Candidates with a Bachelor's degree and adequate computer knowledge are eligible, with preference given to retired Law enforcement officers.

faq.question: Q3. What is the consolidated salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for NLUO Deputy Warden recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 10-11-2026 by 5.00 P. M.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates will be selected through an interview of short-listed applicants.
